content_blocks.text: The old clock in the hallway chimed three times, its metallic voice echoing through the silent house. In the dim light of the moonlight streaming through the window, the walls seemed to whisper secrets. A single candle flickered on the mantelpiece, casting dancing shadows that danced across the room. As she sat by the window, her fingers traced the intricate pattern on the lace curtains, Elianor felt a chill run down her spine. Outside, the night was alive with the soft rustling of leaves and the distant hoot of an owl. She closed her eyes, letting the silence envelop her, and wondered if anyone else could hear the whispers of the past.
